title: Kill the Planner mid-inference

invariants.name: At most one committed template write per action
No template write after revocation unless surfaced for review
Every incident terminal or reviewable within the deadline
No delivery has two acknowledged results
No poison loop (bounded attempts, at most two HTTP 400 refusals per command)
invariants.detail: at most 2 attempt(s) per command, 0 HTTP 400 result(s)

invariants.name: No Executor ledger ends with a write in doubt
Lease ownership exclusive
invariants.detail: 7 delivery lease(s), each held by one identity at a time

invariants.name: No secret in logs, configuration files or argv
Transitions journal consistent with incidents and outbox

limits: Separate OS processes on one host: one kernel clock, one disk, loopback networking. Not separate machines; clock skew is simulated by a gated offset, not measured.
